decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from honojs/hono PR #5102 (fixes issue #5087), merged 2026-07-10. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. In TrieRouter, a route with a regexp-constrained param followed by a trailing wildcard ('/:id{[0-9]+}/*') matched only when the wildcard had a non-empty remainder: '/123/x' matched but '/123' did not. The fix in src/router/trie-router/node.ts pushes the wildcard child's handler set when the regexp consumed the entire remaining path segment. IMPORTANT TEST PRECONDITION: the tests must instantiate TrieRouter directly. Hono's default SmartRouter tries RegExpRouter first, which already handles this case, so a test written against `new Hono()` passes at the base commit and would silently fail the coverage gate. A SECOND PITFALL: TrieRouter builds its params object with a null prototype, so assert.deepStrictEqual against an object literal fails on the prototype check both before and after the fix -- the tests assert individual param fields with strictEqual instead. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (b93a2547); the slice keeps src/, package.json and tsconfig.json and drops .github, benchmarks, perf-measures, docs, runtime-tests and every in-tree *.test.ts. Hono is dependency-free at runtime, so the node-ts image runs the hidden tests with tsx and no install step. Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to return zero handlers at the base commit and match after the gold patch, covering the bare regexp-param match, its captured param, and a wildcard middleware applying to the bare prefix route alongside a sibling route. The 5 pass_to_pass guards cover a non-empty wildcard remainder, a static route, a plain param route, a sibling route on its own path, and a non-matching regexp -- none depend on the empty-remainder case, so they pass at the base commit. NOTE: the non-matching-regexp test was originally written as a fail_to_pass candidate, observed to PASS at base, and moved into the guard.

fail_to_pass.name: wildcard_empty_remainder
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb wildcard matches empty remainder after regexp param$' vb_trie_wildcard.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: empty_remainder_param
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb empty wildcard remainder still captures the param$' vb_trie_wildcard.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: wildcard_middleware_bare_prefix
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb wildcard middleware applies to the bare prefix route$' vb_trie_wildcard.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: wildcard_non_empty_remainder
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb existing wildcard matches a non-empty remainder$' vb_trie_regression.test.ts
